entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Okay! We got the letter of introduction!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Were you asking Shido for mental[n]shutdowns too?

entries.speaker: Shadow Former Noble
entries.en: ...Contrary to past methods, gaining[n]wealth by lineage alone is quite difficult[n]these days.

entries.speaker: Shadow Former Noble
entries.en: That's why I begged to be allowed onto[n]Lord Shido's ship.

entries.speaker: Shadow Former Noble
entries.en: In return for introducing wealthy nobles[n]to him, I requested he enact mental[n]shutdowns for me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I see... So this system of introductions[n]is taking place in reality as well.

entries.speaker: Shadow Former Noble
entries.en: Lord Shido is extremely cautious about[n]the passengers he chooses.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So he's screening potential associates[n]to find wealthy people who won't[n]betray him...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And that's why the passengers are[n]wearing masks. He isn't deceived[n]by people's outward appearances.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: In any case, Ann... your acting skills have[n]developed quite strongly since our nude[n]incident.
